edits.old: No screen. The result of a migration is visible in the release pipeline and in the service's Flyway history: pending, applied, failed, undone, each with a version and a checksum. The tables expose the standard record columns and the validity window of a conflict pair listed in section 9; nothing here is shown to a user directly, and the administration screens SCR-43 and SCR-47 in Epic 8 read the tables through the service's operations, never through SQL.
edits.new:
No screen. The result of a migration is visible in the release pipeline and in the service's Flyway history: pending, applied, failed, undone, each with a version and a checksum. The tables expose the standard record columns and the validity window of a conflict pair listed in section 9; nothing here is shown to a user directly, and the administration screens SCR-43 and SCR-47 in Epic 8 read the tables through the service's operations, never through SQL.

SCR-43 states: empty, loading, error and no access are Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-4958). SCR-47 states: empty, error and no access are Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-4959); its loading state is as defined in Screen Specifications v1 section SCR-47.

edits.old: Then entra_group is varchar(120) and nullable, because a row may have no group in an environment
edits.new: Then entra_group is varchar(120) and nullable, because a row holds no group in an environment where no group is mapped

disposition.note: SCR-43 states added to section 15. Empty, loading, error and no access are Not specified in the source documents, as the screen specification lacks them.
SCR-47 states added to section 15. Empty, error and no access are Not specified in the source documents; loading points to Screen Specifications v1 SCR-47.
Vague 'may' wording in the entra_group Then line of AC2 replaced with a definite statement that names the nullable value.
AC8 in section 7 already tests BR1 to BR9 one Then line per rule, so no new AC10 was added to avoid duplication.
